notes.title: Ho Ho Ho Streamers looks like the holidays have hit
notes.content:
Ho Ho Ho Streamers, what news has come 

We have some exciting news indeed. 

 First, Your Room has been decorated so as to enjoy the holidays


 All starting rooms in the game have been updated with festive cheer


 Ghosts has been updated with animations and scares. 


 We have also added your energy level to your phone, so now you can finally understand why the energy pills (Also will help find ghosts quicker)


But you all want to know about 
 KRAMPUS 

You better watch out because something ain't right. This demon is watching you morning and night. O Krampus is coming to town. It has you on its list and holds its bag nice and tight going to steal your sole tonight. 

So Streamers, you better find it before it finds you. 

So happy holidays and happy hunting, Streamers

notes.title: Several Fixes for all you streamers
notes.content:
Hello Streamers 

Thank you for waiting; we have excellent streaming news for all your followers. 


 First, we have implemented a better tutorial, as many have noticed not everyone knows the cell phone is connected to the tab key. 


Next, we have changed the custom player to a list of players to choose from till we finish building the new customize player in-house. 


 Also, There are three new levels, Small Relaxing Cabin, The Neighborhood, and The Apartments. 


Other add-ons, in multiplayer, you streamers can talk with your other collaborators in the game. 


 Finally, we have added 21 new achievements for all to earn and show off. Let's see who gets the red diamond streamer award. 


The bugs that have been fixed are as followed
1. Fixed tutorial room
2. Fixed player levels system
3. Fixed gear purchasing and selection system
4. Fixed players (No more floating cloths)
5. Fixed the checklist, so now you can do the process of elimination if strapped for scared bucks. 
6. Fixed some server issues (If you still find them, please, let us know)
7. Fixed the Motion Sensor falling through the floor. 

Again streamers, if you have any more comments, problems, or ideas, please let us know in the steam comments, Steam Discussion, or discord. 

Also, if you like the game, please feel free to give the game a thumbs up. 

Again happy streaming ghost hunters. 

Scared Tube Team

notes.title: We are listening to your feedback and brought the updates
notes.content:
Major Update V3.26

We heard you guys, based on the feedback we have made some adjustments in the game.

1.Improved graphics - We have made sure that players could enjoy the great graphics of the game with greater details and scarier effects.

2.Fixed some bugs- due to some unexpected issues we have also pushed small bug fixes such as, player getting stuck in weird areas they explore ex. in a tree or behind small shelves or between fences.

3.Made less servers- servers are more centralized for better gameplay. utilizing servers with better connectivity and less disconnection or down time.

4.Removed character customization for now, will be available in few days- unfortunately we have disabled this for the time being as it has caused some gameplay errors during its release. this will be returning in the next patch which will not be too long from now. 

5.Made tutorial room where you can learn about game functions- this was a much-needed addition as we have received many inquiries on how to use game items. so, a tutorial room was implemented to help our streamers and ghost enthusiast learn how to use each and every item in our inventory.

we are fortunate and happy with how far this game has come and without you our valued audience this would have not been possible. we thank you for your continued support and we look forward to bringing you more in the very near future. 

HAPPY HUNTING

Join our discord for direct communication with our game developers.
